name: Palette_LoadToBuffer
evidence: A=src bank HL=src DE=dst BC=count: selects WRAM bank 7 then far CopyBytes (00:06BC -> 00:050C); 173 far-call sites, every DE lies in $D800-$D87F, the palette staging buffer that 4F:404B uploads; runs in 41/41 scenarios

name: Palette_ReadHardwareToBuffer
evidence: HL=dst: copies the 32 BG colours (rBCPS/rBCPD) then the 32 OBJ colours (rOCPS/rOCPD) of CGB palette RAM to [HL] and [HL+$40] via 4F:4021; callers: the unreferenced wrappers 4F:428E..4471 and 6C

name: Palette_ReadHardwareBlock
evidence: HL=dst B=colour count C=first palette-RAM byte index (bit7 set = OBJ palette RAM): reads each byte through rBCPS/rBCPD or rOCPS/rOCPD; callers 4F:400E only

name: Palette_UploadBuffer
evidence: HL=WRAM palette buffer (normally $D800): writes 64 bytes to BG palette RAM then the next 64 to OBJ palette RAM via 4F:405E; 32 far-call sites plus the fade loops, always after a VBlank wait (00:047A)

name: Palette_UploadBlock
evidence: HL=src B=number of 8-byte blocks C=start byte index (bit7 = OBJ): writes C|$80 to rBCPS/rOCPS (auto-increment) and streams 8 bytes per block to rBCPD/rOCPD; BG call bc=$0800, OBJ call bc=$0880

name: PalFade_BlendColor
evidence: DE=byte offset of one colour: mixes source [$D880+DE] toward target [$D900+DE] by progress word [$D980+DE] (0 = source, high byte set = target, else per-channel RGB555 lerp) and stores the result at [$D800+DE]

name: PalFade_ScaledDelta
evidence: A=start B=end C=fraction/256: returns H = signed (A-B)*C/256 using 4F:4153 (negates around the multiply when A<B); called once per 5-bit channel by PalFade_BlendColor

name: PalFade_Mul8x8
evidence: HL = A * C by 8 shift-and-add iterations; callers: PalFade_ScaledDelta only

name: PalFade_Start
evidence: A=step (bit7 = run from the target back to the palette), BC=target colour RGB555, [C2ED]=range mode: stores target/progress ($0000, or $0100 when bit7)/step in C2EE..C2F2 and fills the $D900/$D980 arrays; 8 internal + 1 bank-48 caller

name: PalFade_Step
evidence: Advances the 16-bit progress [C2F0/1] by step [C2F2] (clamps at $0000/$0100 and clears the step when done), refills $D980 for the range and blends every colour; Z = no fade running, NZ = a step was done

name: Function_4F_428E
evidence: unreferenced: WRAM bank 7, VBlank wait, Palette_ReadHardwareToBuffer(HL=$D800), restore, then FALLS THROUGH into Palette_FadeInFromWhite (4F:42B4): capture the live palette, then fade in

name: Palette_FadeInFromWhite
evidence: Copies $D800->$D880, PalFade_Start(step $E0, target $7FFF), LCDOn, then per frame: VBlank wait + Palette_UploadBuffer + PalFade_Step until done; 82 far-call sites after a screen was built; 41/41 scenarios

name: Palette_FadeInFromWhiteSlow
evidence: Same as 4F:42B4 with step $F0 (twice as many frames); one caller (bank 0E), executed in 35 scenarios

name: Function_4F_434A
evidence: unreferenced: same capture prologue as 4F:428E, falls through into Palette_FadeOutToWhite (4F:4370)

name: Palette_FadeOutToWhite
evidence: Copies $D800->$D880, PalFade_Start(step $20, target $7FFF) then per frame upload + PalFade_Step until done (no LCDOn); 218 far-call sites, typically before a screen change (then 00:09B6); 41/41 scenarios

name: Palette_FadeOutToWhiteSlow
evidence: Same as 4F:4370 with step $10; one caller (bank 0E), executed in 7 scenarios

name: Function_4F_4400
evidence: unreferenced: same capture prologue as 4F:428E, falls through into 4F:4426 (fade in from black, step $F0)

name: Function_4F_4426
evidence: unreferenced (only reached by fall-through from 4F:4400): copy $D800->$D880, PalFade_Start(step $F0, target $0000), LCDOn, upload+step loop: slow fade in from black

name: Function_4F_4471
evidence: unreferenced: same capture prologue as 4F:428E, falls through into 4F:4497 (fade out to black, step $10)

name: Function_4F_4497
evidence: unreferenced (only reached by fall-through from 4F:4471): PalFade_Start(step $10, target $0000) upload+step loop: slow fade out to black, no LCDOn

name: Function_4F_44DF
evidence: unreferenced: range mode 3 (OBJ colours 56-59 only), step $F0, target $7FFF, LCDOn: fade in from white for one OBJ palette

name: Function_4F_452A
evidence: unreferenced: range mode 3, step $10, target $7FFF: fade one OBJ palette to white; mode 3 uses offset $60 in the step but $D9F0 in the setup (possible original inconsistency)

name: TileCanvas_UploadRect
evidence: DE=VRAM dst, HL=(H row, L col) in the WRAM tile canvas, BC=(B rows, C cols): HDMA-copies each canvas row (00:0787) to consecutive VRAM tiles; canvas = 20 tiles x 16 B per row, rows 0-11 in WRAM bank 2, rows 12-23 in bank 3; 42 callers

name: Tilemap_FillAscendingWithAttr
evidence: HL=dst in the $D000 map buffer, BC=(B rows, C cols), DE=(D attr, E first tile): writes ascending tile ids to [HL] and D to [HL+$400] (attr plane), stride $20; tile 256 sets attr bit3 (VRAM bank 1); 59 callers, WRAM bank 7

name: TileCanvas_FillRect
evidence: HL=(H row, L col), BC=(B rows, C cols), DE=16-bit pattern: fills that rectangle of the 20-tile-wide tile canvas (WRAM banks 2/3, 16 B per tile) with DE repeated (0000 = blank, FFFF = solid); 37 callers, mostly bank 4E/67/68

name: Browser_Entry
evidence: Called from the title menu (7C:7BA3); verifies the save block (4E:46CF / reset 4E:4749), then the Browser_StartMenuLoop; executed only in homepage/browser_* and monkey scenarios (10 of 41)

name: Browser_StartMenuLoop
evidence: Loop head: re-checks the save block, calls 73:5F17 (start menu: strings homepage / page list) and dispatches its result through Table_4F_4698: 0 return, 1 home page, 2 page list, 3-5 -> Function_4F_4717

name: Browser_StartHomePage
evidence: Menu result 1: 4E:46A3, snapshot of flags [C69F] to [C2CC], 4E:48CB (loads the home URL) then back to the start menu; executed in 7 scenarios (browser_*, homepage, monkey_camp_*)

name: Browser_StartPageListEntry
evidence: Menu result 2: 4E:46A3, page-list UI 24:4018 (returns HL = chosen SRAM entry or 0), copies the $100-byte URL to $C380, SRAM off, then 4E:493B loads it; executed in 4 scenarios incl. browser_bookmarks

name: Boot_ClearAndInit
evidence: Boot stage 2 (called from Boot at 00:0314): SCX/SCY=0, WY=$90, WX=$A7, palettes $E4, clears C000-CAEF, FFA4-FFFD, VRAM bank 1/0 and WRAM banks 2-7, APU on, 00:0684/04A0/059F, 7D:7BF0, LCDC=$83, IE=1; 41/41 scenarios

name: Boot_ReinitRuntime
evidence: Warm re-init reached through the ROM0 wrapper 00:1711 (called by 65:4000): LCDC=$83, white palettes, clears HRAM FFA4-FFFD, C000-CAEF and WRAM banks 2-7, reinstalls vectors (00:0684/04A0/059F), 7D:7BF0; 41/41 scenarios
